page_title: Karen Nyberg Shows How You Wash Hair in Space
publisher: NASA (Expedition 36, ISS, 2013-07-12); Internet Archive item uploaded by a nasa.gov account (john.l.stoll@nasa.gov)
contents: Expedition 36 flight engineer Karen Nyberg on the ISS demonstrates washing her long hair: squeezes warm water from a pouch onto her scalp, no-rinse shampoo, combing, towel; water clings and floats; mentions the water is recycled by the ECLSS. Original ProRes 720p master re-encoded to H.264 720p. Original YouTube copy (NASA channel) not checked: YouTube blocked this container.
